name: Depth Field
description: An emerging image cloud with circular rotation, pronounced perspective growth, a shared entrance pulse and fading scroll impulses.

controls.name: speed
controls.label: Drift speed
controls.description: Continuous forward travel speed through the cloud, in depth units per second.

controls.name: entryBurst
controls.label: Entry speed
controls.description: Peak forward speed of the entrance pulse. Rotation shares the same speed multiplier; both ease back to their normal speeds. Changing it replays the catalog preview.

controls.name: entryDuration
controls.label: Entry duration (s)
controls.description: Duration of the entrance pulse from an empty image field. The first quarter accelerates; the remaining three quarters ease back into drift.

controls.name: entryDelay
controls.label: Entry delay (s)
controls.description: Wait before the entrance starts. The heading and buttons are already visible while the image field stays empty. Only time on screen counts, and it has no effect when Entry duration is 0. Changing it replays the catalog preview.

controls.name: scrollBoost
controls.label: Scroll acceleration
controls.description: Strength of a brief forward impulse while scrolling in either direction. Acceleration ramps up smoothly and fades after scrolling stops.

controls.name: rotationSpeed
controls.label: Rotation speed (°/s)
controls.description: Circular angular speed in degrees per second. A uniform screen scale keeps the orbit circular at every viewport shape. The entrance shares the forward speed multiplier.

controls.name: spread
controls.label: Spread
controls.description: Distance from the center of the image field. Larger values leave more space around the text.

controls.name: depth
controls.label: Depth
controls.description: Distance across which images approach and fade in. Source images are assigned independently of spatial and arrival order, so repeated images do not progress as a spiral.

controls.name: count
controls.label: Image count
controls.description: Number of image planes. The supplied images repeat through the field.

controls.name: imageSize
controls.label: Image size
controls.description: Base size of each image’s longest edge. Approaching images grow more strongly while moving outward from the vanishing point and beyond the viewport.

controls.name: imageRadius
controls.label: Image border radius (px)
controls.description: Corner radius on the fixed base image box; scales with the image. Zero keeps sharp corners.
